841	 * for too long on ECC (and, hence, X.509 or SSL/TLS) operations.

844	 * - Adds xxx_restartable() variants of existing operations in the
845	 *   following modules, with corresponding restart context types:
846	 *   - ECP (for Short Weierstrass curves only): scalar multiplication (mul),
847	 *     linear combination (muladd);
848	 *   - ECDSA: signature generation & verification;
849	 *   - PK: signature generation & verification;
850	 *   - X509: certificate chain verification.
851	 * - Adds mbedtls_ecdh_enable_restart() in the ECDH module.
